title: Sales & CS Early-Triage: Consolidation, Scoring, and First-Pass Scopes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Define a lightweight, repeatable process for the Sales and Customer Success (CS) teams to submit, consolidate, and get a first-pass scope/estimate for non-bug enterprise feature requests. Goal: reduce time-to-first-answer from weeks to 3 business days for prioritized asks, improve consistency of asks we accept into product discovery, and provide a defensible prioritization signal for engineering and GTM leaders.
triage_rubric: Overview: score asks across five dimensions (Customer Value, Revenue Signal, Strategic Alignment, Implementation Complexity, Compliance/Risk). Produce a single normalized score to drive prioritization during the weekly intake sync.
Customer Value (0-10): clarity of user impact, ARR/MAU affected, contract blockers. Evidence: customer quote, contract docs, number of customers impacted.
Revenue Signal (0-10): current or potential revenue tied to the ask (renewal at risk, upsell opportunity, new logo). Use sales-reported ARR bucket estimates.
Strategic Alignment (0-10): fits roadmap themes (privacy, reliability, dedicated deployments, cost optimizations). PM assigns alignment tags.
Implementation Complexity (0-10): coarse engineering effort estimate (S, M, L mapped to 2, 5, 13). Includes infra, runtime, console, and compliance changes.
Compliance/Risk (0-10): legal/regulatory surface, data residency, encryption/KMS needs, auditability. Higher score = higher risk/complexity and reduces priority unless mandated.

Weights & normalized score: Customer Value x0.35 + Revenue x0.25 + Strategic x0.20 - Complexity x0.15 - Risk x0.10. Thresholds: >=6.5 -> immediate discovery; 4.0-6.4 -> backlog grooming; <4.0 -> deprioritize/templated reply.
weekly_workflow: 1) Intake form (Sales/CS): single canonical form in Salesforce/Asana with required fields: customer, contract id, ask summary, business outcome, expected timeline, screenshots/attachments, revenue estimate.
2) Aggregation: PMs pull new items every Monday into the Intake board. Duplicate detection: check product/feature overlap and mark duplicates for consolidation.
3) Initial scoring: PM performs rubric scoring within 24 business hours and records scores on the Linear ticket.
4) Triage sync (Wed 10:00): Sales Rep, CS lead, Eng liaison, and PM review top scored asks. Determine path: Discovery, Backlog, Decline (with messaging), or Fast-track (engineering quick patch).
5) Assign next steps: Discovery owner (PM or Solutions Eng), initial scope template filled, target discovery milestone (2-4 weeks), and expected decision gate.
6) Communication: templated reply for each outcome recorded in Salesforce and copied to customer thread with timeline and next steps.
sample_scopes: Dedicated VPC/networking request: first-pass scope includes: backend infra changes (VPC peering or private link), authentication/KMS design, audit logging surface, estimate: M (5) eng points, compliance touchpoint required.

SLA / SLO uplift for enterprise tier: scope includes: metrics to track, console changes for SLA display, backend redundancy changes, legal SLA language, estimate: L (13) eng points, cross-org review required.
Role-based access controls (fine-grained RBAC): scope includes: API auth model changes, console UI, audit logs, migration strategy, estimate: L (13) eng points, security review required.

Feature flagging for model rollouts (per-customer model pinning): scope includes: routing policy changes, tenant mapping, config UI, estimate: M (5) eng points, potential runtime performance implications.
acceptance_criteria: Every intake ticket has a completed rubric score recorded in the ticket within 24 business hours of aggregation.
Top-tier asks (score >=6.5) have an assigned discovery owner and a documented 1-2 page discovery brief within 5 business days.
Sales/CS receive a templated response indicating outcome and next steps within 3 business days of triage sync.
Discovery briefs include clear success metrics, minimal viable scope, and risk checklist (security, compliance, infra).
